user.title: Firewalla MSP Setup
user.description: Configure your Firewalla integration to control firewall rules. You'll need your MSP domain and personal access token.

data_description.access_token: Your personal access token from the Firewalla MSP account

reconfigure_box.title: Choose this entry's Firewalla box
reconfigure_box.description: This entry was set up before v1.2.1 without saving which box it is for, and your MSP account has more than one box. Choose the box so its status entities can load. Existing entities and their history are kept.

data_description.box_gid: The box this entry's rules and entities belong to

box_selection.title: Select Firewalla Box
box_selection.description: Choose which Firewalla box to manage rules for. The integration will discover all existing rules and create switch entities for each one.

data_description.box_gid: Select the Firewalla box whose rules you want to control

error.invalid_url_format: Invalid MSP domain format. Enter your subdomain only (e.g., 'mydomain').
error.auth_failed: Invalid access token. Please check your token in MSP settings.
error.connection_failed: Cannot connect to MSP service. Please check your internet connection and MSP URL. Make sure the domain is correct.
error.no_boxes: No Firewalla boxes found in your MSP account. Please ensure your box is properly registered.
error.box_already_configured: That box already has its own Firewalla entry. Choose another box.
error.box_not_found: These credentials cannot reach the configured Firewalla box. Use credentials for the MSP account that holds it.
error.rule_access_failed: Cannot access rules. Please check your MSP permissions.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Please try again.
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please check your configuration.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Firewalla MSP API. Please check your MSP URL and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid MSP API credentials. Please verify your personal access token.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Firewalla box is already configured. Each box can only be configured once.
abort.box_identity_changed: This entry's box was being set while this form was open. Open Reconfigure again.
abort.legacy_entry_needs_box: This account already has a Firewalla entry set up before v1.2.1 that isn't matched to its box yet. Open that entry's Reconfigure and choose its box first, then add this box.
abort.repair_target_missing: This entry's upgrade to v1.2.1 was interrupted before it saved which box the entry belongs to, so the integration can't safely choose a box and won't load. Restore a Home Assistant backup from before the upgrade, or open an issue at {issues_url} for a guided repair. Don't delete and re-add the integration: its entities would be created again without their customizations and history.
abort.invalid_host: The provided MSP URL is not valid. Please check the URL format.
abort.auth_failed: Authentication with the Firewalla MSP API failed. Please check your credentials.

init.title: Rule Filtering Options

data_description.include_filters: Rules matching these filters will be included. If empty, all rules are included by default. One filter per line.
data_description.exclude_filters: Rules matching these filters will be excluded. Use '-' prefix or just the filter. One filter per line.
